hero.description: Kansas City brings the 2026 tournament to Arrowhead Stadium — consistently rated the loudest stadium in the world. The City of Fountains surprises every visitor with world-class barbecue, a jazz heritage, and a soccer culture that quietly punches well above its weight. Don't sleep on KC.

stadium.name: Arrowhead Stadium
stadium.transport: Arrowhead Stadium is about 13 km southeast of downtown Kansas City in the Truman Sports Complex. No direct public transit — the KC Streetcar does not reach the stadium. Game-day shuttles, rideshare, and driving are the primary options. Allow 30–45 min from Downtown on match days.

quick_facts.fan_hub_status: Fan hub expected at Power & Light District; confirm local schedules

weather.june: Warm and sometimes stormy, highs 27–31°C (81–88°F). Thunderstorms are common in June.
weather.july: Hot and humid, highs 30–34°C (86–93°F). Can be intense outdoors.
packing_tips: A light rain jacket or compact umbrella — Great Plains thunderstorms are fast and heavy
Sunscreen for outdoor fan zones and pre-match areas
Layers for cooler evenings — temperatures can drop 10°C after a storm passes
Comfortable shoes — Downtown KC is walkable within zones

airports.name: Kansas City International Airport
airports.distance_to_stadium: About 35 km northwest of Arrowhead Stadium
transfer_options: KC Streetcar doesn't reach the airport — rideshare from MCI to Downtown takes 25–35 min
Rental car practical for staying in the KC area if you plan multiple day trips
airports.notes: The newly rebuilt MCI terminal opened in 2023 — modern and efficient. Rideshare is the easiest option. No rail connection currently exists between the airport and downtown.

match_schedule.teams_or_placeholder: Arrowhead Stadium hosts group stage matches. Full schedule after group draw.

public_transit: No direct rail to Arrowhead — the Kansas City area has limited transit
Game-day shuttles expected from downtown collection points — confirm details before each match
KC Streetcar runs through downtown but does not extend to the sports complex
rideshare: Rideshare is the most practical option from Downtown to Arrowhead — 30–40 min
Post-match surge is significant — walk away from the main gates before requesting a pickup
Pre-book scheduled Uber or Lyft before kickoff for better pricing
driving_parking: Arrowhead has extensive parking — tailgate culture is huge here and lots fill early
Pre-book preferred lots online to secure a spot near the main gates
I-70 and Blue Ridge Cutoff back up significantly after matches — plan 60+ minutes for departure
walking_biking: Not walkable from Downtown Kansas City
Local shuttle options from parking lots to stadium gates are available
match_day_tips: Arrowhead is legitimately one of the loudest stadiums in the world — the atmosphere will be extraordinary
Tailgating in the lots is a Kansas City tradition — arrive 2–3 hours early for the full experience
The Truman Sports Complex has Kauffman Stadium (baseball) next door — check for same-day conflicts
KC BBQ joints are everywhere near the stadium — Arrowhead's tailgate BBQ scene is world-class

fan_hubs.name: KC Fan Hub — Power & Light District
fan_hubs.location: Power & Light District, 1327 Grand Blvd, Kansas City
fan_hubs.description: Kansas City's premier entertainment district is expected to be the center of World Cup fan activity — open-air blocks with bars, restaurants, and big screens within easy walking distance of Downtown hotels. This is where KC locals go for every major sports celebration.
transport_tips: KC Streetcar to Main & 13th stop, short walk to Power & Light
Walking distance from most Downtown hotels
Rideshare easily available throughout the entertainment district

neighborhoods.name: Downtown / Power & Light
neighborhoods.safety_transit_notes: Safe in the entertainment district and Power & Light area. Downtown core is well-patrolled.
neighborhoods.stadium_access: Rideshare or shuttle to Arrowhead — 30–40 min
neighborhoods.description: Best base for fan hub access and Downtown nightlife. Several major hotels in or near the Power & Light entertainment district. KC Streetcar connects to Union Station and River Market.

neighborhoods.name: Crossroads Arts District
neighborhoods.safety_transit_notes: Safe gentrifying area — active and well-lit in the restaurant zone.
neighborhoods.description: Kansas City's most dynamic neighbourhood with the First Fridays art walk, independent restaurants, and the best cocktail bars in the city. Walking distance from Downtown.

neighborhoods.name: Westport
neighborhoods.best_for: Nightlife, Irish pubs, local bar scene
neighborhoods.safety_transit_notes: Active nightlife area — safe on main corridors.
neighborhoods.description: KC's longtime bar and nightlife district with Irish pubs, outdoor spaces, and a lively match-day scene. One of the best places in the city for an international football crowd.

hotels.name: Loews Kansas City Hotel
hotels.best_for: Luxury, convention center, Power & Light access

hotels.name: The Westin Kansas City at Crown Center
hotels.best_for: Crown Center shopping, families, Hallmark museum

booking_links.label: Browse all Kansas City hotels on Booking.com →

bars.name: The Dubliner
bars.notes: Kansas City's best Irish pub with a soccer-watching tradition. Packed and loud for major matches.

bars.name: Power & Light District (multiple venues)
bars.notes: The entire Power & Light District becomes a fan zone on match days — multiple bars, outdoor screens, and thousands of people.
bars.transit: KC Streetcar to Main & 13th, walking distance

bars.name: Westport Social
bars.notes: Large outdoor bar and activities complex in Westport. Great afternoon atmosphere for wide broadcast matches.

bars.name: Grünauer
bars.notes: Austrian-style bar in the Crossroads Arts District. Excellent beer selection and a European football atmosphere.

bars.name: O'Neill's Irish Pub
bars.notes: River Market Irish pub with early morning soccer showings and a passionate international crowd.

transport.summary: Kansas City is a car-centric city. The KC Streetcar connects Downtown, Crossroads, and Crown Center — but does not reach Arrowhead. Rideshare or game-day shuttles are the only options for the stadium.
tips: KC Streetcar is free to ride and covers the main Downtown corridor from River Market to Crown Center
Book rideshare in advance for post-match — demand at Arrowhead is intense after sold-out events
MCI Airport has no rail connection — rideshare from the airport is about 30 min to Downtown
Parking at Arrowhead is extensive but fills fast — arrive 90 min early if driving

fan_zones.name: KC Fan Hub — Power & Light District
fan_zones.location: Power & Light District, 1327 Grand Blvd, Kansas City
fan_zones.description: KC's entertainment hub with outdoor bars, restaurants, and giant screens. The natural gathering point for Downtown-based fans throughout the tournament.

soccer_culture.community_notes: Kansas City punches above its weight in American soccer. Sporting KC has one of the most passionate MLS fanbases in the league, and the region's Mexican and Central American communities bring genuine football culture. The Children's Mercy Park atmosphere is one of the best in MLS.

tourist_hits.name: National WWI Museum and Memorial
tourist_hits.notes: America's only official World War I museum — exceptional and moving. One of the best museums in the Midwest.

tourist_hits.name: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
tourist_hits.notes: World-class free art museum with a remarkable collection. Don't miss the shuttlecock sculptures outside.

tourist_hits.name: Country Club Plaza
tourist_hits.notes: Outdoor shopping and dining district with Spanish architecture. Beautiful in the evening.

local_favorites.name: Crossroads First Fridays
local_favorites.notes: Monthly arts walk in the Crossroads district — galleries open late, food vendors, and live music. Check if it coincides with your stay.

local_favorites.name: River Market Farmers Market
local_favorites.notes: Excellent Saturday market with local produce and the most diverse street food in KC.

local_favorites.name: Swope Park
local_favorites.notes: Large urban park with trails, a golf course, and the Kansas City Zoo.

areas: Power & Light District — most concentrated bar and restaurant zone
Crossroads Arts District — craft cocktails and independent restaurants
Country Club Plaza — upscale dining and outdoor shopping

recommendations.name: Joe's Kansas City Bar-B-Que
recommendations.notes: Widely considered the best BBQ in Kansas City, which makes it among the best in the world. Long lines at lunch — arrive early.

recommendations.name: Q39
recommendations.notes: Competition-quality BBQ in a restaurant setting. More accessible than Joe's for dinner service.

recommendations.name: Corvino Supper Club
recommendations.notes: One of KC's best fine-dining experiences in the Crossroads. Book ahead.

local_resources.emergency_info: Emergency: 911. Kansas City Police non-emergency: (816) 234-5111. Hospital: University of Kansas Hospital, (913) 588-5000.

walk_bike.walkability_summary: Downtown, Crossroads, Power & Light, and Westport are walkable within their zones. The City of Fountains has pleasant streetscapes, and the Streetcar corridor is pedestrian-friendly.
walk_bike.bikeability_summary: BCycle Kansas City bikeshare operates in Downtown and surrounding neighbourhoods. The Streetcar corridor has bike lanes.
walk_bike.bike_share_notes: BCycle KC has docks throughout Downtown, Crossroads, and Country Club Plaza. Day passes in the BCycle app.

pickup_soccer.name: Swope Soccer Village
pickup_soccer.location: 5800 Swope Memorial Dr, Kansas City, MO
pickup_soccer.access_notes: KC's premier soccer facility with open fields. Active youth and adult pickup culture.

pickup_soccer.name: Penguin Park
pickup_soccer.location: 2900 NE Vivion Rd, Kansas City, MO
pickup_soccer.access_notes: Northside park with informal soccer and a community atmosphere.

outdoors_day_trips.name: Ozark National Scenic Riverways
outdoors_day_trips.distance: About 230 km southeast of Kansas City in Missouri
outdoors_day_trips.notes: Float the Current or Jacks Fork rivers in crystal-clear spring water. Canoe rentals available at multiple outfitters — a classic Midwest summer experience.

outdoors_day_trips.name: Tallgrass Prairie National Preserve
outdoors_day_trips.distance: About 200 km southwest of Kansas City in Kansas
outdoors_day_trips.notes: One of the last remaining tallgrass prairie ecosystems in North America. Hike among wild bison and experience the original Great Plains landscape.

safety_tips: Kansas City is safe in the main tourist areas — Power & Light, Crossroads, Westport, and Crown Center
Use rideshare or the KC Streetcar for late-night travel — avoid walking in unfamiliar areas
KC thunderstorms can be severe — always check the forecast before outdoor fan events
The Truman Sports Complex area is well-managed on match days
Keep valuables secure in fan zones — pickpocketing in dense crowds is possible
